Get LBA Player

Source: R/lba.R
lba_player.Rd

Player bio with current-season totals, highs and averages (one row).

Endpoint: GET https://www.legabasket.it/api/players/get-player-by-id (stats=1&id=<player_id>)

Usage

lba_player(player_id)

Arguments

player_id

(required) Player id (player_id in lba_players or a box score), e.g. 969. Global: one id for a whole career.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player bio with current-season totals, highs and averages (one row). The columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py lba_player); a column the site adds later is appended after them:

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer id (global).
codecharacterPlayer code SURNAME3-NAME3-YY.
namecharacterPlayer's given name.
surnamecharacterPlayer's family name.
place_of_birthcharacterBirthplace (Italian spelling).
birth_datecharacterBirth date, Date YYYY-MM-DD.
updated_atcharacterTimestamp, ISO-8601 with the Italian offset.
ext_codecharacterExternal (data feed) player code; equals code in the samples.
seo_meta_titlecharacterSEO title (null in the samples).
seo_meta_descriptioncharacterSEO description (null in the samples).
photo_picture_keycharacterImage key: the image is {cdn_url}/{key}, resized copies {cdn_url}/variants/{key}/thumb or /large (the site's getApiImageUrl).
fullbody_picture_keycharacterImage key: the image is {cdn_url}/{key}, resized copies {cdn_url}/variants/{key}/thumb or /large (the site's getApiImageUrl). Null in every sample.
start_datecharacterContract start with the team, Date YYYY-MM-DD.
end_datecharacterContract end with the team, Date YYYY-MM-DD.
player_numbercharacterJersey number, number sent as a string.
uefa_ratiocharacterEligibility class for the foreign-player quota: I, E or C (7 / 6 / 1 on the Treviso roster; reading as Italian / EU / non-EU is inferred).
heightintegerPlayer's height in centimetres.
weightintegerPlayer's weight in kilograms.
team_idintegerTeam id (team-season) of his current team.
player_role_descriptioncharacterPosition, Italian (see players[].player_role of the roster route).
player_alpha3characterNationality, ISO alpha-3.
player_country_namecharacterNationality, Italian country name (Italia = Italy); map to English through player_alpha3 (ISO 3166 alpha-3), not by translating the name.
player_countrycharacterContinent, Italian name (Europa = Europe; the other values are presumably Africa, America, Asia, Oceania, unobserved).
team_codecharacter<season>\|<team code> of his current team (2026\|TVU).
team_namecharacterTeam name in that season, with its sponsor (Nutribullet Treviso Basket); changes with the sponsor.
yearintegerSeason START year (2026 = 2026-27); sdv END year = year + 1. The season of the team the row places the player on.
team_logo_keycharacterImage key: the image is {cdn_url}/{key}, resized copies {cdn_url}/variants/{key}/thumb or /large (the site's getApiImageUrl).
stats_played_matchesintegerGames played this regular season.
stats_totals_highs_rs_player_idintegerPlayer id (global, one per career).

stats_totals_highs_rs_played_minutes_sumintegerCurrent regular-season total of minutes played.

stats_totals_highs_rs_suffered_fouls_sumintegerCurrent regular-season total of fouls drawn.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in lba_championships().
